it is possible by means of winding rectifier integration to adjust the ac component of winding capacitance from 0 to 95% in a transformer with a rectifier connected to its secondary side.

the ac winding capacitances of high-voltage, high-frequency transformers can be adjusted by means of windingrectifier integration, that it is virtually possible to choose between ac winding and dc winding capacitances during the transformer design, and that this is important in applications such that resonant converters with capacitive filters.

the design and optimization of the winding capacitances in high-frequency power transformers for applications with rectifier loads.
the development of a method to adjust ac and dc winding capacitances in high-frequency transformers with rectifier loads.
the design of a high-frequency power transformer with an integrated rectifier, which is capable of delivering power in the range of a few kilowatts.
